**Map making.** Claude can now build maps: edit and create them, connect them, give them their own art from a PNG tileset, and put them on the Town Map and the Fly menu. 46 tools, up from 26.

### New maps and connections

- **`create_map`** makes a map modeled on an existing one, with its tilesets, music and weather, in any bank or a new one.
- **`connect_maps` / `disconnect_maps`** join or separate neighboring maps, on both maps at once. A neighbor that would overlap another one, or not touch the edge, is refused.
- **`resize_map`** grows or shrinks a map on any side. NPCs and connections stay lined up.
- **`add_fly_spot`, `read_town_map`, `paint_town_map`** make a map a Fly destination and put it on the Town Map.
- **`list_region_names`, `add_region_name`** give a place a new name. The game's name list can't grow, so the new name goes into a free slot: FireRed has 3, Emerald over 100.

### Events and blocks

- **`add_map_event` / `remove_map_event`** add or remove NPCs, warps, triggers and signs. Pass `message` and a simple talk script is written for an NPC or sign. Removing a warp renumbers warps on other maps that lead past it.
- **`read_map_blocks` / `paint_map_blocks`** read and paint a map's blocks and walkability. Copy a building by reading it in one place and painting it in another.
- **`view_blockset`, `view_tiles`, `view_overworld_sprites`** show a map's blocks and tiles, and the NPC sprites, each labeled with its number.
- **`read_block`, `write_block`, `list_block_behaviors`** show and change what a block looks like and how it behaves (tall grass, water, door, ...).

### Custom tilesets

- **`import_tileset`** turns parts of top-down PNG tilesets into a map's own tileset. Ground becomes solid blocks; objects like trees, rocks and houses go on top, with transparency. Colors are fitted to the GBA's palettes, and duplicate and mirrored tiles are stored once. The result tells you how much of the GBA's limits you've used, and gives the new block ids ready to paint. A tileset can mix several images.

### Fixes and improvements

- `write_table_field` can fill an empty pointer with new data, e.g. a surf table for a route that has none.
- Misspelled names in learnsets and trainer teams are refused instead of quietly stored as something else.
- `decompile_script` shows texts inline even when HMA hadn't recognized them yet.
- Tilemaps export as indexed PNGs, and an image identical to what's already there is no longer written back.
- `find_map` says whether each map is a town, route or indoor map.
- `scripts/install.ps1` updates an installed server even while Claude is using it.

### Tested on

FireRed (U) 1.0 and Emerald (U), including two craftpix top-down tilesets. See [docs/limitations.md](https://github.com/dewayneku/hma-mcp/blob/main/docs/limitations.md) for what's not covered and the GBA's tileset limits.

### Download

| You use | Get |
|---|---|
| Claude Desktop | `hma-mcp-win32.mcpb`, `hma-mcp-darwin.mcpb` (Apple Silicon) or `hma-mcp-linux.mcpb`, then double-click it |
| Claude Code, other clients | `hma-mcp-<system>.zip` / `.tar.gz`; unpack and point your client at `hma-mcp` ([setup](https://github.com/dewayneku/hma-mcp#quick-start)) |

The builds are self-contained, so you don't need .NET. On macOS, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine <folder>` on a downloaded build before starting it.
